events.name: Vernon Farmers' Market Fall Market at O'Keefe Ranch
events.description: A one-day fall market at Historic O'Keefe Ranch with vendors from the Vernon Farmers' Market: local produce, baking and artisan goods. The ranch's corn maze, haunted mini golf, heritage buildings and animals are open the same day, and a beginner square dance lesson runs at 2:45 p.m. ($10).
